summary: PCEP has been extended to support stateful path computation, where the PCE tracks paths and resource use. Those extensions did not meet all the needs of GMPLS-controlled networks. This document adds the extensions to PCEP needed to use a stateful PCE in GMPLS networks.

eli5.summary: A route planner that remembers all current trips can plan better. This teaches it to do so for optical-style networks with special rules.
